旧版 English: Where is repeated asset work using up your budget?
旧版中文: 重复的资产制作与交接，占用了多少预算？
新版 English: Is your game asset queue outgrowing your team?
新版中文: 游戏资产需求增加，团队的制作能力能跟上吗？

旧版 English:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Is repeated modeling and file handoff taking time from your game?

Tripo Studio Team Plan combines AI 3D creation with team control:
• Generate character and prop starting models from text or images.
• Pool credits and reuse models in a shared library.
• Manage access and member usage in one workspace.

Leave your details to discuss a trial around your asset list.
旧版中文:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

反复建模和文件交接，是否正在占用游戏项目的制作时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版把 AI 3D 创作与团队管理结合起来：
• 从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始模型。
• 共享积分，在共享资产库中复用模型。
• 在同一工作区管理访问权限和成员用量。

留下联系方式，围绕你的资产清单沟通团队试用。
新版 English:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Is a growing asset queue leaving your artists less time to refine the game?

Tripo Studio Team Plan helps your game team create first-pass 3D characters and props from text or images, pool credits and reuse assets in one workspace. Artists still refine and approve what ships.

Plan a 10-asset pilot against your current process: generation, cleanup, review and reuse. Discuss your asset list and trial availability.
新版中文:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

资产制作需求不断增加，是否挤占了美术成员完善游戏的时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版支持游戏团队从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始3D模型，共享积分，并在同一工作区复用资产。最终用于项目的资产，仍由美术成员精修并审核。

规划一次包含10项真实资产的试点，对照现有流程，评估生成、精修、审核与复用的投入。沟通你的资产清单及可用的试用安排。

旧版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）
新版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）

旧版 English:
Generate a starting model from text or images, then refine it for the game. Smart Mesh offers quad topology; HD Model provides detailed source geometry that may need retopology. Continue with materials and your existing tools.

A searchable team library keeps assets available for review and reuse, instead of another file request. Shared credits and usage controls keep team resources together.

Leave your details to discuss your workflow and a team trial.
旧版中文:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再按游戏要求完善。Smart Mesh 提供四边面拓扑；HD Model 提供细节丰富的源模型，高模可能需要重拓扑。随后继续处理材质，并衔接已有工具。

可搜索的团队资产库方便审核与复用，减少再次索取文件的环节；共享积分和用量管理则便于统一管理团队资源。

留下联系方式，沟通你的工作流程与团队试用。
新版 English:
Generate first-pass models from text or images, then let artists refine them in their existing tools and check them in the game.

Shared credits, access controls and a searchable asset library keep team resources together. Another teammate can find and reuse reviewed work rather than request a new file.

Plan a 10-asset pilot to compare the whole process with how your team works today. Leave your details to discuss the plan and trial availability.
新版中文:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再由美术成员在现有工具中精修，并在游戏中检查。

共享积分、访问权限管理和可搜索的资产库，让团队资源集中管理。另一位成员可以查找并复用已审核的资产，减少重新索取文件的环节。

规划包含10项资产的试点，把完整流程与团队现有做法进行比较。留下联系方式，沟通试点计划及可用的试用安排。

旧版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）
新版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）

旧版 English:
Choose a small character and prop list from your game. Compare your current process with a team trial: time spent generating, refining, reviewing and handing off each asset. Include generation credits, retries and the artist work needed to meet your game's requirements.

Also test how members find and reuse assets, and how admins manage access and usage.

Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and trial availability.
旧版中文:
从游戏项目中选择一小组角色与道具。团队试用时，对照当前流程，记录每项资产在生成、精修、审核和交接上的时间；把生成积分、重试和达到游戏要求所需的美术工作也计入。

同时测试成员如何查找与复用资产，以及管理员如何管理访问权限和用量。

留下联系方式，沟通资产需求及试用安排。
新版 English:
Choose 10 real characters and props. Define what counts as useful and approved for your game.

Compare your current workflow with a pilot: time to first useful model, generation credits and retries, artist cleanup, review and engine checks. Record whether another teammate can find and reuse each approved asset.

Count the full effort, not just generation time. Leave your details to discuss a pilot plan and trial availability.
新版中文:
选择10项真实角色与道具，先明确什么样的模型算可继续制作、什么样的资产算通过游戏项目验收。

对照现有流程与试点：记录首个可继续制作的模型所需时间、生成积分与重试、美术精修、审核及引擎检查；再记录另一位成员能否找到并复用每项已审核的资产。

统计完整投入，而不只看生成时间。留下联系方式，沟通试点计划及可用的试用安排。

旧版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）
新版动作/目的地: leadgen:原生留资表单（审核模拟）

旧版 English: Trial access is subject to program terms and availability. A Tripo-registered email is required before trial benefits can be issued.
旧版中文: 试用以活动条款和可用名额为准。试用权益发放前，需要核对已在 Tripo 注册的邮箱。
新版 English: Generated models are starting points; your team refines and approves final use. Trial access depends on program terms and availability; a Tripo-registered email is required before benefits are issued.
新版中文: 生成模型是制作起点，精修及最终使用仍由你的团队审核。试用以活动条款和可用名额为准；权益发放前须核对已在Tripo注册的邮箱。

旧版中文: 留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产制作需求及团队试用。
新版 English: Discuss your 10-asset pilot plan and trial availability with Tripo. Your team defines project checks and approves final assets.
新版中文: 与Tripo沟通10项资产试点计划及可用的试用安排。由你的团队确定项目检查要求并审核最终资产。

旧版中文: Tripo 将使用这些信息跟进本次团队试用咨询。请查看隐私政策。

旧版 English:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

When the game needs more assets, is your team still handling each generation request by hand?

Tripo API brings 3D generation into your own game tools:
• Generate character and prop starting models from text or images.
• Submit tasks and track status programmatically.
• Retrieve completed models for artists to review and refine.

Move repeated request handling into your workflow. Open Quick Start.
旧版中文:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

游戏需要更多资产时，你的团队还在手动处理每一次生成请求吗？

Tripo API 把 3D 生成接入你现有的游戏工具：
• 从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始模型。
• 程序化提交任务并查询状态。
• 取回已完成的模型，由美术成员检查并精修。

把重复的请求处理纳入自己的工作流程。打开 Quick Start，了解接入步骤。
新版 English:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Could your game asset tools offer 3D generation without your team building the underlying model stack?

Use Tripo API as the 3D generation layer in your tools, rather than building the underlying model stack. Submit text or images, track asynchronous tasks and retrieve models. Your team controls the interface, asset review and engine checks.

Plan a 10-asset API test to compare quality, retries, cleanup time and total cost before scaling.
新版中文:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

游戏资产工具需要3D生成功能，是否一定要让团队从头搭建底层生成模型？

把Tripo API作为工具中的3D生成层，不必从头搭建底层生成模型。提交文字或图片，查询异步任务状态，再取回模型；交互界面、资产审核和引擎检查仍由你的团队掌控。

先规划一次10项真实资产的API测试，对比质量、重试、精修时间和总成本，再决定是否扩大使用。

旧版 English:
Submit text or images to generate a starting model. Your tool checks task status and retrieves the output when complete. Add supported mesh, texture or format-conversion steps where the asset needs them.

This can replace repeated manual request handling, while your artists keep responsibility for project fit. Open Quick Start to see the calls.
旧版中文:
提交文字或图片，生成初始模型。由你的工具查询任务状态，并在完成后取回结果，再按资产需要加入受支持的网格处理、贴图或格式转换步骤。

这可以替代重复的手动请求处理，美术成员仍负责判断资产是否符合项目要求。打开 Quick Start，查看调用步骤。
新版 English:
Your tool submits text or images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task. Your team reviews geometry, materials and target-engine performance before approving the asset.

Tripo provides the generation layer; your team implements the interface and integration. Open Quick Start for the request flow.

Tripo提供生成层；交互界面和系统接入由你的团队实现。打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程。

旧版 English:

A completed task is not an approved game asset. Test the outputs against your project's mesh, material and performance requirements. Open Quick Start to plan the integration.
